title: Initial litter chemistry and seasonality drive potentially toxic element cycling during decomposition in a subtropical forest: insights from monospecific and mixed litter
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2035-2048
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00248F, Paper
